title: Image cache entries can be invalidated
summary:
Image cache invalidation arrived, an Android community app joined the directory, and model metadata and usage accounting got tidier.

A new DELETE endpoint accepts the original image prompt and query parameters to invalidate a cached result. Its JSON response reports the outcome for each cache store.

The community-built Android app was added to the Chat projects listing and project directories. It brings Pollinations-powered chat, web search, and image generation to a phone.

Text and image model lists now label pricing in Pollen and expose the specialized-model flag as `is_specialized`. Shared registry data also supplies Enter’s model descriptions and modalities, while alias cleanup removes a few misleading entries.

highlights.title: Invalidate cached images
highlights.text: Send DELETE to `/delete/prompt/:prompt` with the original prompt and query parameters to invalidate an image cache entry. The JSON response reports the deletion results.
